{{Current events|year=2019|month=03|day=23|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->

;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**[[Battle of Baghuz Fawqani]]
***The [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] announce the capture of the [[Al-Baghuz Fawqani|last territory]] held by [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] in Syria. [https://www.dw.com/en/islamic-state-defeated-in-syria-us-backed-syrian-forces/a-48036014 (DW)]
*[[Northern Mali conflict]]
**[[March 2019 attacks against Fulani herders]]
***At least 134 [[Fulani herdsmen]] are killed in an attack on the villages of Ogossagou and Welingara by gunmen in [[Mali]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mali-security/at-least-134-fulani-herders-killed-in-central-malis-worst-violence-yet-idUSKCN1R40K9 (Reuters)]
*[[Somali Civil War]]
**In [[Mogadishu]], [[Somalia]], at least five militants set off a [[car bomb]] and raid a government building, killing at least five people. [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] claim responsibility for the attack. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/03/23/world/africa/somalia-bombing-gunfight-shabab.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/africa/explosion-heard-in-somali-capital-mogadishu/2019/03/23/16cc00dc-4d49-11e9-8cfc-2c5d0999c21e_story.html?utm_term=.da9c4b1c0e9b (''The Washington Post'')]

;Business and economy
*''[[The Wall Street Journal]]'' reports that former [[Enron]] CEO [[Jeffrey Skilling]], released from prison in February after serving 12 years for fraud and insider trading following [[Enron scandal|Enron's 2001 collapse]], is planning a return to the energy business, helming a "digital platform connecting investors to oil and gas projects". [https://www.wsj.com/articles/ex-enron-ceo-skilling-plots-second-act-11553282732 (''The Wall Street Journal'')]. 

;Disasters and accidents
*Rescuers scramble to rescue about 1,300 passengers and crew from the cruise ship [[MV Viking Sky|''Viking Sky'']] adrift off the coast of [[Norway]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/03/23/europe/norway-cruise-ship-evacuation/index.html (CNN)] 

;International relations
*[[China–Italy relations]]
**Italy signs $2.8 billion in deals with the [[Belt and Road Initiative]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-italy-china-deals-factbox/italy-signs-deals-worth-2-5-billion-euros-with-china-idUSKCN1R40KN (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Opposition to Brexit in the United Kingdom]]
**Approximately one million Britons assemble for the [[2019 People's Vote March|People's Vote March]] in London, United Kingdom advocating for an additional referendum on [[Brexit]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-47678763 (BBC)] [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/live/2019/mar/23/brexit-hundreds-of-thousands-expected-to-march-for-peoples-vote-london-live-updates (''The Guardian'')]
